key: KXAIRDROPHYPE|Will Hyperliquid conduct an airdrop before Oct 1, 2025?|If Hyperliquid conducts an airdrop before Oct 1, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes. An airdrop is defined as the distribution of fungible tokens to multiple wallet addresses where recipients receive tokens without paying the full market value. This includes free distributions requiring only gas fees, distributions requiring donations less than 10% of market value, retroactive rewards, task-based distributions, and phased distributions where initial tokens are received before the deadline. Token sales where recipients pay 10% or more of market value, ICOs, IDOs, employee compensation, liquidity mining rewards, staking rewards, NFTs, non-transferable tokens, and unconverted points do not constitute airdrops. The airdrop must be conducted (tokens actually distributed) before the deadline, not merely announced.
reasoning: Hyperliquid conducted a major airdrop of its HYPE token on November 29, 2024, distributing 310 million tokens (31% of total supply) to over 90,000 addresses. This was a free distribution to users based on participation points, with no purchase required. This event occurred before the October 1, 2025 deadline and clearly meets the resolution criteria for an airdrop: distribution of fungible tokens to multiple wallet addresses where recipients received tokens without paying the full market value.
